purpose: Compare two generators against three arbiters without claiming historical execution or authorizing spend.

found_actual_paths.evidence: benchmark none; expanded low and medium artifacts
six-target benchmark, expanded off/low artifacts, and deepseek_limits_v2 variants

fairness_protocol.candidate_reuse: Generate once per generator, then reuse the identical saved first candidate for all three arbiters.
fairness_protocol.repair: At most one additional repair per branch, using the same generator; keep receipts separate.
fairness_protocol.compatibility: Never edit models into an existing SH04 run or bypass manifest compatibility.
fairness_protocol.adapter_boundary: The ordinary shorten_file CLI binds one model to both roles. Mixed generator/arbiter pairs require a separate experiment path and adapter; do not invent a public --arbiter flag. Generic run_trial supports distinct roles but is not itself evidence that the public CLI does.

measurements.coverage: Every selected target and branch receipt, including unresolved and protocol failures.
measurements.protocol: ID mapping, target-only output, schema validity, context boundary, and manifest compatibility.
measurements.budget: Request, token, repair, unknown-state, and cost ledgers with unresolved denominator retained.
measurements.current_audio_fit: Run the same original-audio preflight where selected; measured fit is separate from model acceptance.
measurements.model_audit: Semantic audit meaning, model identity, cost, latency, and disagreement; raw accept count is not semantic ground truth.
measurements.blinding: A checker receives no history or first-verdict identity; use blinded case and verdict IDs.
measurements.independent_checker: Still pending. Two families across a generator/arbiter pair do not automatically provide a third independent family.

optional_sh06_control.description: If the question is whether an arbiter helps, add an equally budgeted length-only-repair control with the same first candidate and one extra attempt.
optional_sh06_control.do_not_confuse: Raw accepted counts are not semantic correctness.

cost_and_scope_boundary.no_cost_claim: No new paid request or cost is authorized by this proposal.

blocking_gaps: zero-budget policy is pending and must be explicit before execution
development corpus selection, size, and budget are not frozen
historical_scope_note: The historical 48-target expanded artifacts repeat the same 48 targets twice; they are not 96 independent targets. Old protocol caps and the current normalized calibrated profile must not be combined for a new model rank.
